projects.title: We Fly Together
projects.description:
AS Travel Club is one of the most well-known travel agencies in Kosovo, which was founded in 2009 by professionals in this field, with more than 30 years of experience.

AS Travel contacted us to manage their social media and create a new feel. We brought creative designs, presenting tourist places in a more unique form by creating an impressive icon for each place. And within the designs we have included attractive slogans.

As a general slogan, we used the name of the agency in a pun for a meaningful message "Let AS show you the world".
